You're so lucky, Pipi. You can fly...
(The sparrow perched on the boy's head chirps as though it understands him. Then it flutters toward someone.)
strings.피피. 어디 가? 피피!: Pipi. Where are you going? Pipi!
Pipi? Oh, so this Sylphin's name is Pipi.
strings.이런 새들을 실핀이라고 해요. 옛날에는 정령이었는데, 세월이 지나 지금은: That's what these birds are called. They were spirits long ago, but over time they became birds like this.
strings.헤에, 피피. 너 정령이었구나. 그런데… 누구세요…?: Wow, Pipi. You used to be a spirit. But... who are you...?
strings.어, 이름 들어본 적 있어요. 다른 대륙의 악당을 무찔렀다는 소문 들었거: Oh, I've heard your name. I heard rumors that you defeated villains on another continent.
That's true, but I didn't do it alone. A lot of people helped.
That's amazing. Why would someone so impressive come to see me...?
strings.엠블라에게 라스를 도와달라는 부탁을 받았어요. 무언가 잘 안되는 것 같다: Embla asked me to help you, Lars. She said something seemed to be troubling you.
How did she know? I haven't told anyone... All right, I'll tell you.
I want to meet an angel. Then I'll wish to become an adult.
I heard that if you meet an angel, your wish comes true. I want to grow up quickly. Adults can do anything.
strings.도크알프 엘프들은 마력이나 신성력 같은 게 없으면 따로 뭔가를 배울 기회: For Dokkalfr elves, unless you have magical or divine power, there aren't many chances to learn things. You have to rely on books.
strings.엠블라 누나나 아스크렌 형처럼 마을 밖을 나가는 특수한 경우 아니면 대부: Apart from special cases like Embla and Askren, who travel outside, most people in Nidaros never leave the village. They just spend their lives doing village work.
I'm not saying that's bad... But the adults tell me to just keep living like this. Honestly, it feels suffocating.
strings.이런 이야기를 할 수 있는 또래 친구도 없고, 잘 들어주는 어른도 없어서: I don't have any friends my age to talk to about it, or adults who'll really listen, so I just... want to grow up.
strings.어른이라고 뭐든 다 할 수 있는 건 아니고, 천사님도 모든 소원을 들어주: Adults can't do everything, and angels don't grant every wish. There isn't a special shortcut to growing up, either...
strings.그런데, 그레고리 할아버지는 천사님을 만나 소원을 이뤘다고 했어요. 파도: But Grandpa Gregory said he met an angel and had his wish granted. The waves calmed down, and he caught lots of fish.
That can happen when someone prays earnestly. But listen carefully, Lars.
strings.내가 천사님께 라스를 만나 달라고 할 수는 없지만…, 천사님께 축복해달라: I can't ask an angel to meet you... But I can ask one to bless you.
strings.정말이에요. 거짓말 아니에요. 대신, 약속 하나 해요. 어른이 되고 싶단: Really. I'm not lying. But promise me one thing. Don't make a wish like wanting to become an adult...
If you make the wrong wish, a devil comes instead.
strings.(시간이 빠듯하긴 하지만, 빨리 다녀오면 될 것 같네.): (I'm short on time, but I should be able to make a quick trip.)
Is it really true? That %s will ask an angel to bless me...?
strings.오냐. 그런데 저 사람하고 무슨 이야길 나눈 게냐?: Hello there. What were you talking about with that person?
%s says they know an angel. So...
strings.%s 와서 미카 너무 기뻐. 오늘은 무슨 일이야…?: Mika is so happy you came, %s. What brings you here today...?
strings.(미카엘라에게 니다로스에서 오게 된 사정과 라스라는 소년에 대해 간단하게: (You briefly explain to Michaela why you came from Nidaros, and tell her about the boy Lars.)
Mika understands. I'll bless that boy.
So we'll be sparring again, Michaela...
We'll spar too, but take what Mika gives you to Ur.
%s, come here. Mika wants to greet you.
strings.(미카엘라가 %s의 곁으로 다가가 살며시 볼키스를 한다.): (Michaela approaches %s and gently kisses your cheek.)
Oh! Uriella, who was outside the Tower of Trial! The one who said she'd changed how she talked...
strings.잘은 모르지만, 너 우르를 잊고 있던 것 같아. 이제 우르 기억할 수 있: Mika isn't sure, but it seems you had forgotten Ur. Now you should be able to remember her.
strings.미카 잘은 모르지만, 다양한 시간 속에 네가 있었던 것 같아. 어떤 너는: Mika doesn't really know, but it seems there were versions of you in different timelines. Some of you seem to have met Ur.
Oh, I can't linger. I'm short on time, so I need to hurry...
All right. Mika will wait for you at the far end of Hyle.
Sparring's over. Thank you, %s. Mika feels much better now.
This is Mika's feather. Give it to Ur.
No, I'm the one who should thank you.
Come visit again later. Mika will be waiting.
strings.(미카가 투박한 상자를 들고 와 %s에게 건넨다. 뚜껑을 열자 달콤한 쿠: (Mika brings a plain box and hands it to %s. Opening the lid releases the sweet aroma of cookies.)
strings.(우물우물) 이거 맛있어. 젤릭이라는 사람이 만들었다는 걸 아우룸이 가져: (Munch, munch.) These are delicious. Aurum brought them. Someone called Jelic made them.
strings.하나는 %s 거. 가면서 먹어. 다른 하나는 우르, 또 하나는 라피에게: One portion is for you, %s. Eat it on your way. Another is for Ur, and the last is for Rapi.
Thank you for the food, Michaela. I'll come back with news of the other angels.
strings.(우리엘라가 조용히 다가와 살며시 볼키스를 한다.): (Uriella approaches quietly and gently kisses your cheek.)
Look how startled you are. Hehe. Anyway, I'm relieved.
I was worried you'd forgotten me, but you remembered and came back. Thank you.
How could I forget you angrily saying, 'Ur says...'?
strings.잊어, 잊으라고! 바보!: Forget that! I said forget it, you fool!
strings.(우리엘라가 화를 내자 뒤로 보이는 탑이 흔들린다.): (As Uriella loses her temper, the tower behind her shakes.)
I'm sorry. Please calm down. The reason I came today is... this...
strings.어머, 이거 뭐야?! 미카 깃털이잖아. 빨리 줘! 빨리!: Oh my, what's this?! It's Mika's feather. Give it here! Hurry!
strings.(우리엘라가 깃털을 두 손으로 받자마자 가슴쪽으로 꼭 끌어안는다. 그러자: (As soon as Uriella receives the feather in both hands, she clutches it to her chest. A warm light comes drifting on the breeze from somewhere and brushes past her.)
Mika... You've been waiting for us for so long...
strings.우르는, 미카, 라피, 가브 기다릴 거야. 여신님께서 곧 만나게 해 준다: Ur will wait for Mika, Rapi, and Gab. The goddess said we'll be able to meet soon.
strings.아, 나는! 나는! 나는!: Oh, I mean I! I! I!
Uriella, this is a gift from Michaela.
strings.어, 먹을 거네? 우와, 이거 뭐가 이렇게 맛있어? 미카는 항상 이런 거: Oh, something to eat? Wow, how is this so delicious? Does Mika always eat things like this? I'm jealous.
strings.%s, 너 지금 시간 없지 않아? 엘프 남자아이에게 천사의 축복을 받아다: %s, aren't you short on time? You promised to get an angel's blessing for an elf boy.
strings.아, 아직 말씀 안 드렸는데, 어떻게 아세요?: Oh, I haven't told you yet. How did you know?
strings.미카 깃털로 조금은 느낄 수 있었어. 지금 바로 해줄 순 없지만, 네가: I could sense a little through Mika's feather. I can't do it right now, but if you go see Rapi, I think I'll be able to help properly afterward.
strings.가브까지 만나면 완벽하겠지만, 가브가 어디 있는지 아무도 모르잖아. 괜찮: It would be perfect if you could see Gab too, but no one knows where she is. It's all right. Seeing Rapi will be enough.
I'll give him a true blessing, with all my heart. Blessings are Uriella's specialty.
strings.가브라면 가브리엘라 님을 말씀하시는 거죠?: By Gab, you mean Gabriella, right?
Yes. Somehow, I feel we'll be able to see her soon.
strings.헤헤, 그러면 너무 좋겠지? (우물우물) 히히. 아, 미카가 그랬던 것처: Hehe, wouldn't that be wonderful? (Munch, munch.) Hehe. Oh, get a feather from Rapi too, just as you did from Mika.
Oh, I've eaten them all... I should have asked %s for one more before they left.
strings.킁. 킁. 맛있는 냄새다. 어! %s!: Sniff, sniff. Something smells delicious. Oh! %s!
strings.(라파엘라가 환한 미소를 보이며 %s에게 달려든다.): (Raphaella rushes at %s with a bright smile.)
strings.미안, 라피 너무 심심했어. 헤프링 말고 다른 얼굴 보는 건 진짜 오랜만: Sorry. Rapi was so bored. It's been ages since I saw a face other than Hefring's.
strings.헤프링하고 뒹굴면서 지냈지! 헤프링이 라피 이러고 있으면 살 빠진다고 도: Rolling around with Hefring! Hefring said I'd lose weight living like this and brought mountains of packed lunches.
So I've been thanking Leon and blessing him every time.
strings.자, 라피 인사받아. 어?!: Now, let Rapi greet you. Huh?!
strings.(라파엘라가 %s에게 볼키스를 하려다 말고 살짝 멈춘다.): (Raphaella pauses just before kissing %s on the cheek.)
strings.%s, 미카하고 우르 만나고 온 거야? 우르가 돌아왔어?: %s, did you come after seeing Mika and Ur? Is Ur back?
Yes. Uriella appeared a few days ago, and I met her.
strings.그리고 우리엘라 님이 미카엘라 님 깃털을 사용해서 미카엘라 님의 기억을: And I think Uriella used Michaela's feather to read her memories.
That's why I need one of your feathers too.
Good, good! Take one after we spar. You can pluck them all if you like.
strings.응. 라피도 오래 걸리는 건 싫으니까, 빨리 끝내자. 그러면 나 유적 끝: Yes. Rapi doesn't like taking too long either, so let's finish quickly. I'll wait at the far end of the ruins.
strings.여기서 대련하지 않는다는 선택지는 없나요?: Is choosing not to spar an option?
strings.아, 가셨다…. 어쩔 수 없지. 유적 끝까지 가봐야겠네. 길도 외웠으니까: Oh, she's gone... It can't be helped. I'd better head to the end of the ruins. I know the way by heart now, so it should be fine. Phew...
strings.우하하, 역시 대련은 즐거워. 실컷 즐겼으니 이제 끝. 자, 깃털 원하는: Wahaha! Sparring is so much fun. I've had my fill, so we're done. Go ahead and take as many feathers as you want.
Thank you, Raphaella. One feather will be enough, though.
Oh, right. What I left over there is a gift Michaela asked me to bring.
Oh, that smell! Food! Ooh, cookies.
strings.(우물우물) 와아, 너무 맛있어. 미카의 선물이라 그런가? 더 맛있는 기: (Munch, munch.) Wow, they're so good. Is it because they're a gift from Mika? They taste even better.
strings.이 쿠키 만든 엘프를 제가 아는데요. 이거 말고도 맛있는 음식을 많이 만: I know the elf who made these cookies. He makes lots of other delicious food too.
Rapi wants to try it too. Sob.
strings.울지 마세요. 언젠가 미카엘라 님, 우리엘라 님, 가브리엘라 님하고 함께: Please don't cry. Someday, you'll be able to eat lots of delicious things with Michaela, Uriella, and Gabriella.
strings.라피도 꼭 그렇게 될 거라고 생각해. 그런데 혹시 가브는 만났어?: Rapi believes that will happen too. By the way, have you met Gab?
strings.아직요. 어디 계신지 몰라 아직 뵙진 못했지만, 만나게 된다면 바로 소식: Not yet. I don't know where she is, so I haven't met her, but I'll bring you news right away if I do.
Rapi is so happy to finally know how Mika and Ur are doing.
Oh, Raphaella. Please have the rest of mine too. I've eaten plenty.
strings.시간이 촉박해서 이만 가 볼게요. 대신 다음에 꼭 충분히 시간 내서 라파: I'm short on time, so I need to go. But next time, I'll make sure I have plenty of time to visit you.
All right. Thank you, %s. Take care.
I'm short on time. Uriella, I brought Raphaella's feather.
strings.생각보다 빨리 와서 놀랐어. 조금 늦어도 괜찮아. 지금 네가 우리 일을: You came back faster than I expected. It's all right if you're a little late. Time will flow a little differently while you're helping us.
strings.미카가 네게 작은 축복을 걸었어. 마찬가지로 나도 네게 도움이 되고 싶어: Mika placed a small blessing on you. I wanted to help too, so I added the same blessing.
That silly Rapi noticed you had an angel's blessing and did the same.
We really are sisters. We think alike in things like that.
strings.(우리엘라가 라파엘라의 깃털을 두 손으로 감싸안는다. 그러자 전보다 더: (Uriella cups Raphaella's feather in both hands. A brighter light than before rides the breeze, circles around her, and soon disappears.)
Rapi has been through so much too...
strings.후우, 나도 더 힘내야지. 모두 만날 수 있도록 마음 단단히 준비할 거야: Phew. I need to be stronger as well. I'll prepare my heart so we can all meet again.
strings.고마워, %s. 그러면 나도 그 아이를 위해 축복해 주려고 하는데, 뭐가: Thank you, %s. Now, I'd like to bless that boy too. What would be best?
strings.역시 그 나이 아이에게 어울리는 게 좋겠지? %s, 이 셋 중에 하나 골: Something suited to a child his age, of course. %s, tell him to choose one of these three.
strings.첫 번째 축복은 지식의 정령이 공부를 도와줘서 몰랐던 부분을 일부 깨우쳐: The first blessing will have a spirit of knowledge help him study, giving him insight into things he didn't understand.
strings.두 번째는 음식의 정령이 입맛을 북돋워 줘서 성장기에 어떤 음식이든 맛있: The second will have a spirit of food improve his appetite, so he can enjoy any food while he's growing.
strings.세 번째 축복은 감정의 정령이 머무르면서 소중한 것을 더욱 아끼고 표현할: The third blessing will let a spirit of emotion stay with him, helping him treasure what matters to him and express his feelings.
strings.라스가 선택하면 축복이 바로 전해지나요?: Will the blessing reach Lars as soon as he chooses?
strings.나는 직접 갈 수 없으니까 그 아이가 구한 실핀을 통해 축복이 내려질 거: I can't go in person, so the blessing will come through the Sylphin he rescued. Lady Iris has given her permission too.
strings.아, 실핀이라면 라스 머리에 있는 참새 말씀하시는 거죠?: Oh, by Sylphin, you mean the sparrow on Lars's head?
strings.맞아. 강풍에 휩쓸려 벽에 부딪힌 걸 그 아이가 구해줬어. 거기다 실핀: That's right. A strong wind swept it into a wall, and that boy saved it. He treated its injured leg too. Most people would simply have walked past... That's more than enough to deserve a blessing.
strings.우리가 아니더라도 누군가는 그 애를 축복했을걸. 그 아이가 착한 아이라서: Even if we didn't bless him, someone else would have. I'm glad he's a kind child.
Me too. Well, Uriella, I'd better go.
Wait. You have to receive my greeting before you leave.
Goodbye. See you next time. Don't forget to bring armfuls of cookies.
I'm sorry. It's all my fault.
strings.어른이 되고 싶다는 소원을 빌려고 했던 것도, 그냥 축복받고 싶다고 바란: Wanting to wish myself into an adult, and simply wanting a blessing. All of it...
strings.결과란 건 과정이 있어야 하잖아요. 그걸 모르고 과정 없이 한 번에 이루: Results need a process behind them. I didn't understand that, and I tried to get everything at once without putting in the work...
Even your trip to meet the angels must have been difficult, %s.
strings.피피를 살린 건 그냥 우연이었어요. 축복을 받고 싶어서 한 일이 아닌데…: Saving Pipi was just a coincidence. I didn't do it because I wanted a blessing...
strings.천사님이 라스를 칭찬했어요. 천사님이 축복을 내리지 않아도 누군가가 상을: The angel praised you, Lars. She said even if an angel didn't bless you, someone would have rewarded you.
strings.(그 순간, 라스의 머리 위에 있던 실핀이 날아올라 이마를 콕콕 쪼아 댄: (At that moment, the Sylphin on Lars's head takes flight and pecks at his forehead.)
Pipi says to stop being silly and make your choice.
strings.그러면 고마운 마음으로 받을게요. 첫 번째…. 공부는 지금도 혼자 잘 하: Then I'll accept it gratefully. The first... I'm already doing well studying on my own, so I don't need that.
The second might make me as greedy for food as Carmen, so I'm not sure about that.
strings.소중한 걸 더욱 아끼고 표현할 수 있다는 건가. 어쩌면 지금 제게 필요한: To treasure what's important and express my feelings better... Maybe that's what I need right now.
strings.(왠지 모르게 마음이 따뜻해지네. 이걸로 잘 된 거겠지….): (Somehow, I feel warm inside. I suppose that means it all worked out...)
Did I really receive a blessing? I feel just the same as usual...
strings.그동안 저 때문에 많이 고생하셨어요. 저는 이만 카르멘 누나에게 가볼게요: You've gone through so much trouble for me. I'll go see Carmen now.
strings.안 그래도 저번에 누나한테 싫은 소리를 엄청 했거든요. 사실 진심도 아니: I said some really nasty things to her last time. I didn't even mean them.
I said even Hefring, who eats an incredible amount, doesn't eat like she does...
I should go apologize. She's my only sister...
Goodbye. So you're staying at that inn over there...
strings.그레고리 할아버지! 낚시하고 오세요?: Grandpa Gregory! Have you been fishing?
strings.오냐. 그런데 라스, 혹시… 천사님을 만난 게냐?: I have. Lars, by any chance... did you meet an angel?
strings.그건 아니에요. 축복 같은 걸 받긴 했는데…. 어라? 그걸 어떻게 아셨어: No, I didn't. I did receive something like a blessing, though... Huh? How did you know?
I've felt the energy around you once before.
When I was young, I too received an angel's blessing, quite by chance...
